logic_action_check.name: logic_action_check
logic_action_check.value: ("builder"."form_logic_rules"."action_kind" = 'GO_TO_STEP' AND "builder"."form_logic_rules"."target_step_id" IS NOT NULL AND "builder"."form_logic_rules"."target_field_id" IS NULL) OR ("builder"."form_logic_rules"."action_kind" IN ('SHOW_FIELD','HIDE_FIELD') AND "builder"."form_logic_rules"."target_field_id" IS NOT NULL AND "builder"."form_logic_rules"."target_step_id" IS NULL) OR ("builder"."form_logic_rules"."action_kind" = 'END_FORM' AND "builder"."form_logic_rules"."target_step_id" IS NULL AND "builder"."form_logic_rules"."target_field_id" IS NULL)

versions_status_check.name: versions_status_check
versions_status_check.value: ("builder"."form_versions"."status" = 'DRAFT' AND "builder"."form_versions"."published_at" IS NULL) OR ("builder"."form_versions"."status" = 'PUBLISHED' AND "builder"."form_versions"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)
